# assessed entity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assessedEntity`](gmeow-assessedEntity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessedEntity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/quality`](../../slices/quality.md)

The entity whose data quality is being assessed — the feature of interest of the quality observation. Sub-property of [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) so generic consumers can query 'all observations about Alice' without knowing whether the claim is a name, a coordinate, or a quality assessment.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:QualityAssessment`](../classes/gmeow-QualityAssessment.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md)
